newsitem.title: USA: Colonial Data, US Order close merger.
newsitem.headline: Colonial Data, US Order close merger.

text.p: Colonial Data Technologies and US Order Inc said in a joint statement on Thursday they completed their merger of equals today after shareholders of each company approved the transaction.
The new company, to be called InteliData, will begin trading on Nasdaq on Nov. 8.

InteliData will concentrate on electronic commerce, consumer telecommunications devices, and an integrated line of caller identification products through both telephone companies and retailers, the companies said.
In the merger, about 32.1 million new shares of InteliData stock were exchanged for 16.6 million shares of US Order and 15.5 million shares of Colonial Data stock through a one-to-one exchange ratio.
InteliData begins operations with about $43 million in cash, short-term investments and restricted cash and no long-term debt, the companies said.
